review.assessment: The change creates a new `solution.sh` that simply pipes stdin into `grep -v '^#'`. This only filters lines starting with `#` at the very first column and completely ignores blank lines, failing both core requirements of the task specification. As a result, the script leaves whitespace-only lines and indented comments in the output.

findings.actual: blank lines are printed to stdout
findings.defect: Fails to strip blank or whitespace-only lines.

findings.actual: indented comment line is printed to stdout
findings.defect: Does not match or remove lines where the first non-whitespace character is '#'.
